# DC segmenting Markdown to wiki renderer (pure capability)

## Problem and existing contracts
Jira Data Center stores rich text as wiki markup, while rebar authors Markdown. DC currently sends that Markdown literally. Whole-body pandoc is unsafe: measured with pypandoc-binary 1.15 / pandoc 3.6.1, it escapes prose and inline-code arrows, erodes Markdown table delimiters, and deletes the <!-- rebar:reconciler-echo --> marker.

This story adds an unwired pure renderer. WikiTextCodec.fit_outbound keeps its 32,767-character truncation contract; normalize_outbound and to_wire remain identity on strings; decode_inbound remains identity on strings and maps None to empty. OutboundFieldMapper, CREATE, normalize_rich_text, and every live send path remain unchanged. Story 3388 owns cutover with echo suppression and convergence. Story 5c0e owns timeout/process and GPL/SBOM hardening before cutover. Jira Cloud uses ADF and is handled by the separate Cloud child, so wiki rendering is DC-only.

ADR 0083 governs vendor-adapter imports. Add ADR 0095 to record why selective segment rendering was chosen, its safety invariants, the pandoc pin, and the deferred cutover/hardening boundaries.

## Reproducible corpus
The prior ephemeral export is unavailable, so no acceptance criterion uses its 179/70 or 68/78 claims. Commit a scrubbed, deterministic stratified sample generated by scripts/build_dc_wiki_corpus.py: code_arrow.json has 29 bodies, table.json has 29, and prose.json has 120, for 178 total. The generator uses a fixed seed, scrubs before writing, includes every available body exhibiting the protected phenomena plus a prose sample, and keeps each shard below the repository 500 KB limit.

Each record declares its source text and expected protected excerpts. The generator is provenance, not a test oracle derived from renderer output. Add tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus to EXCLUDED_PREFIXES in scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py because captured JSON is not authored criteria text. Tests reject emails, tenant hostnames, and URLs in committed fixtures.

Define rendered-body ratio as bodies containing at least one safe unit successfully converted by real pandoc divided by 178. Define rendered-character ratio as source characters belonging to successfully converted safe units divided by all source characters. The committed sample was independently measured at 0.927 and 0.984; tests require >=0.90 and >=0.95. Identity fallback cannot pass because eligible fixtures declare safe units and tests require their output to differ.

## Renderer contract
Add adapters/jira_family/wiki_render.py exposing render_markdown_to_wiki(markdown: str) -> str.

Use a left-to-right two-phase lexer. First lock complete existing {noformat}...{noformat} spans and fenced code blocks delimited by backtick or tilde fences, including embedded blank lines. Then split only intervening text into blank-line blocks and list items. Reassembly preserves source order and separators.

Classification is deterministic:
1. Locked {noformat}, fenced code, and already-wiki units beginning with h1.-h6., {code}, {noformat}, or {{ pass through exactly.
2. An ASCII table is two or more pipe-bearing lines with a delimiter row containing only pipes, colons, hyphens, and whitespace. Wrap its exact bytes once in {noformat}.
3. HTML-dangerous means an HTML comment or a tag matching <[/!]?[A-Za-z][^>]*>; pass through.
4. Regex-dangerous means text outside code contains a regex group opener (?; a backslash class such as \b, \d, \s, or \w; or a bracket class followed by a quantifier. Pass through.
5. Remaining headings, quotes, list items, and prose are safe and render through pypandoc with input commonmark, output jira, and --wrap=none.

Code fragments comprise fenced blocks, four-space-indented code blocks, and inline spans delimited by matching runs of one or more backticks. Extract them before arrow work. Protected blocks never reach arrow substitution. Within safe units, replace arrows with a single-pass regex alternation ordered <!--, -->, <->, ->, <-, => and map only the four arrows to ↔, →, ←, ⇒. HTML delimiters map to themselves. Sequential str.replace is forbidden. Inline-code spans are copied verbatim.

After pandoc converts a safe unit, every extracted source code fragment must occur byte-identically and in order in the candidate output. If not, return that source unit unchanged. Existing wiki input remains unchanged, so repeated rendering is deterministic.

On missing pypandoc, return the whole input unchanged and emit a structured warning. On conversion exception or code-preservation rejection, return only that unit unchanged and emit a structured debug log naming the fallback class without body content or secrets. The module stays stateless.

## Dependency, CI, and files
Add optional extra wiki = ["pypandoc-binary==1.15"] and include wiki in dev so local and Gerrit tests use the real bundled binary. Register wiki in rebar._optional.EXTRAS with pypandoc as its probe. Regenerate uv.lock.

In .github/workflows/_optionality.yml add wiki:wiki and extend the joint lane to union:agents,eval,tracing,wiki. Existing test_optionality_loop_covers_every_declared_extra must stay green. A non-skipping test asserts pypandoc.get_pandoc_version() == "3.6.1" and performs real commonmark-to-jira conversion, so a missing writer or platform mismatch fails CI instead of vacuously exercising identity fallback.

Changed paths:
- src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/adapters/jira_family/wiki_render.py
- scripts/build_dc_wiki_corpus.py
- tests/fixtures/dc_wiki_corpus/
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render.py
- tests/unit/rebar_reconciler/test_wiki_render_corpus.py
- pyproject.toml, uv.lock, src/rebar/_optional.py
- .github/workflows/_optionality.yml
- scripts/check_criteria_vocabulary.py
- docs/adr/0095-dc-segmenting-wiki-renderer.md

## Verification
Author all renderer and corpus tests RED-first. Collect the exact nodes without skip/xfail. Then run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make lint`, `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make typecheck`, and `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make test`.

No contention test applies: this is a stateless transformation plus a local process boundary with no store composition, retry/backoff, or cached store state.

## Surface parity
CLI, MCP/API, and public library facade are out of scope because this internal capability is not exposed. Automated callers and dual-direction convergence are out of scope here and proven in story 3388. The Cloud ADF child owns Cloud behavior.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Safe units render through real pandoc in original order; verified by test_dc_segmenting_passthrough.
- [ ] Tables and HTML/regex-dangerous units preserve exact source bytes; verified by test_dc_segmenting_passthrough.
- [ ] Arrow mapping uses the specified single pass, converts prose arrows, preserves all code arrows, and never corrupts -->; verified by test_arrow_substitution_cases and test_dc_arrow_substitution_spares_code.
- [ ] All 29 code-arrow fixtures retain every declared protected excerpt; verified by test_dc_corpus_no_code_arrow_is_ever_rewritten.
- [ ] All 29 table fixtures retain exact table bytes inside one {noformat} wrapper over five passes; verified by test_dc_table_noformat_stable and test_dc_corpus_tables_survive_verbatim.
- [ ] HTML comments survive byte-identically; verified by test_dc_corpus_html_comments_survive.
- [ ] Existing wiki and {noformat} bodies remain exact across five passes; verified by test_dc_already_wiki_body_passes_through and test_dc_corpus_render_is_deterministic_across_passes.
- [ ] Missing pandoc returns the exact body and logs a warning without content; verified by test_dc_pandoc_absent_identity.
- [ ] Conversion and preservation failures return the exact unit and log their class without content; verified by test_dc_pandoc_failure_degrades_that_unit.
- [ ] The wiki extra locks pypandoc-binary==1.15, CI jointly resolves it, and the real binary reports pandoc 3.6.1; verified by the optionality lane and test_dc_real_pandoc_version.
- [ ] Rendered-body ratio is >=0.90; verified by test_dc_corpus_coverage.
- [ ] Rendered-character ratio is >=0.95; verified by test_dc_corpus_coverage.
- [ ] Fixture cardinality is exactly 29 + 29 + 120 = 178; verified by test_corpus_cardinality_is_pinned.
- [ ] Fixtures contain no email, tenant hostname, or URL; verified by test_corpus_carries_no_unscrubbed_secrets.
- [ ] ADR 0095 records the renderer decision and boundaries; checked by review.
- [ ] Existing WikiTextCodec truncation, identity, decode, non-string, and codec-law tests stay unmodified and green under `make test`.
